content.summary: This article first appeared on GuruFocus.  Japanese giants are deepening their stake in the skies.  Air Lease (NYSE:AL), the jet-financing powerhouse built by industry legend Steven Udvar-Hazy, has agreed to a $65-per-share all-cash sale to a group led by Sumitomo Corp., SMBC Aviation Capital, and Brookfield Asset Management.
